description: Find moments across the library by speech, on-screen text, book-page text or visual similarity (multilingual CLIP). OCR includes book pages; book_page searches only book text and observed printed page labels. Returns item_id, start/end seconds, matched text, page_index (zero-based observation, not printed folio), printed_page and keyframe paths when available. Use for production planning and to pick clip ranges. Respect reuse_policy: "reusable" footage (own/licensed) may be cut into new work; "reference_only" third-party media is for analysis, structure and style reference only, never copied into an output.

kinds.description: Choose which indexes to search: speech, OCR, visuals or book-page text.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries or matches to return.

query.description: Search text for matching media library entries or moments.

reuse_policy.description: Filter by the library’s recorded footage reuse policy.

name: media_library_search
title: Search media library
